Returns per-check PASS / FAIL / UNVERIFIABLE with raw evidence and a copy-paste reproduce command, plus an overall CONFIRMED / REFUTED / PARTIALLY_VERIFIED. UNVERIFIABLE means the claim as stated cannot be probed and is therefore not evidence, and it is never reported as PASS. Use it on a stated number, a payout address, a contract ownership claim or an x402 price before you transact with that counterparty.
